seoTitle: Shipping Container Homes India │ Custom-Built │ SAMAN
metaDescription: Shipping container homes with a reinforced MS shell from Rs 3.64 lakh ex-GST. Built for relocation and coastal duty, six sizes, factory-made, pan-India delivery.
opener: Shipping container homes from SAMAN are the reinforced build in our range: heavier 75x75 mm corner posts, a full-height 1.6 mm corrugated MS shell, continuous ridge sealing and zinc-rich primer under the enamel, engineered for relocation and hard weather rather than a single quiet plot. These are newly fabricated container-form homes made in our Bengaluru and Greater Noida works; we do not resell used cargo boxes, and a converted ISO container is only ever a separately quoted option. Prices run from Rs 3,64,320 ex-GST at 20x8 ft to Rs 9,13,920 at 40x12 ft across six sizes.
descriptionHtml:
The shipping-form home is newly fabricated to container dimensions and hardware standards; conversion of a used ISO cargo container is quoted separately on request.

5-year structural warranty and 1-year finishing warranty as standard; finishing warranty extendable to 2 years on request, confirmed at quotation. Typical service life is 20 to 25 years under proper use and maintenance, which is an engineering expectation, not a warranty period.

materialLabel: a full-height 1.6 mm corrugated MS shell
priceCaption: Published prices are ex-factory for the unit as specified, exclusive of GST. Foundation, site levelling, water and drainage connection and the electrical service point are arranged at your site and are quoted separately.
trustWarranty: 5-year structural warranty and 1-year finishing warranty as standard
